invariants.name: Request Authenticity
invariants.purpose: Backend never treats client-decoded Play Integrity token contents as verified evidence without official cryptographic verification.
invariants.positiveTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should verify legitimate Play Integrity token with valid requestHash
invariants.negativeTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should reject token when hooking or emulator signature detected
invariants.failureConsequence: Attacker on rooted Android emulator can forge attestation verdicts and inject synthetic frames.

invariants.name: Request Binding
invariants.purpose: Verified requestHash must equal server's independently calculated SHA-256(nonce:uid:action:captureDigest) digest (<= 500 bytes).
invariants.positiveTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should verify canonical requestHash binding
invariants.negativeTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should reject token when requestHash does not match expected value
invariants.failureConsequence: Replay of genuine device attestation token across different requests, users, or operations.

invariants.name: Freshness
invariants.purpose: Stale or expired attestation tokens or capture frames cannot authorize sensitive biometric operations (max age 180s for token, 60s for capture).
invariants.positiveTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should accept token within 180s freshness window
invariants.negativeTest: play_integrity_attestation.test.ts: should reject expired attestation token
invariants.failureConsequence: Replay of recorded authentic biometric transmissions hours or days after capture.

invariants.name: Single-Use State
invariants.purpose: A single-use business challenge cannot successfully authorize multiple protected operations.
invariants.negativeTest: test_liveness_injection_bypass.test.ts: Replay attack successfully intercepted and blocked (Invariant I-05)
invariants.failureConsequence: Replay attack authorizing multiple enrollments or identity verifications with one challenge.

invariants.name: Envelope Integrity
invariants.purpose: Modification of ciphertext, nonce, authentication tag or required authenticated context causes immediate rejection.
invariants.positiveTest: aad_canonicalization.test.ts: should round-trip canonical AAD with exact binary equivalence
invariants.negativeTest: aad_canonicalization.test.ts: should reject tampered binary AAD buffer
invariants.failureConsequence: Ciphertext manipulation or malicious template forgery.

invariants.name: Tenant Isolation
invariants.purpose: A caller cannot access another tenant's biometric record through ordinary application endpoints; cross-tenant AAD binding prevents template transplantation.
invariants.positiveTest: cross_tenant_isolation.test.ts: Tenant A decrypts Tenant A template successfully
invariants.negativeTest: cross_tenant_isolation.test.ts: Tenant B cannot decrypt Tenant A template with different tenant AAD context
invariants.failureConsequence: Cross-tenant biometric linkage and unauthorized identity matching across isolated organizations.

invariants.name: Key Separation
invariants.purpose: The Cloud KMS KEK is not exported into application plaintext memory. Plaintext DEKs are not persisted and zeroized in RAM immediately after use.
invariants.positiveTest: template_migration.test.ts: creates v3_kms_gcm envelope containing wrapped DEK
invariants.negativeTest: template_migration.test.ts: verifies stored envelope schema contains wrappedDek Buffer, not plaintext DEK
invariants.failureConsequence: Database compromise leads to catastrophic offline decryption of all stored facial embeddings.

invariants.name: Migration Atomicity
invariants.purpose: Migration failures cannot create false success states, silently downgrade security or irrecoverably overwrite source records.
invariants.positiveTest: template_migration.test.ts: MIG-02: Live migration commits valid v3_kms_gcm record and preserves vector fidelity
invariants.negativeTest: template_migration.test.ts: MIG-04: Migration fails safely when source ciphertext is corrupted without damaging state
invariants.failureConsequence: Permanent loss of biometric templates or silent corruption of worker authentication records.

invariants.name: Authorization
invariants.purpose: Knowing a UID, tenant identifier, document path or challenge ID does not grant permission without valid caller credentials.
invariants.positiveTest: security_hardening.test.ts: Authenticated requests with valid tokens succeed
invariants.negativeTest: security_hardening.test.ts: All 4 sensitive biometric endpoints fail-closed with 401 when Authorization header is omitted
invariants.failureConsequence: Horizontal privilege escalation and unauthenticated access to biometric endpoints.

invariants.name: Version Integrity
invariants.purpose: Unsupported envelope and protocol versions are rejected rather than silently reinterpreted.
invariants.positiveTest: template_migration.test.ts: MIG-05: Batch migration handles heterogeneous envelope batches
invariants.negativeTest: template_privacy.ts: throws error when envelope version is unknown or unsupported
invariants.failureConsequence: Cryptographic downgrade attacks forcing execution of obsolete or vulnerable cipher modes.

invariants.name: Audit Privacy
invariants.purpose: Logs and telemetry cannot contain unrestricted biometric payloads, plaintext DEKs, raw tokens or credentials.
invariants.positiveTest: test_manifest.json: tamper_evident_audit test validates log structure
invariants.negativeTest: secret_scan.json: 648 files scanned with 0 leaks of embeddings, DEKs, or credentials
invariants.failureConsequence: Biometric vectors or cryptographic keys leaked into log monitoring systems.

invariants.name: Fail-Safe Behavior
invariants.purpose: A required security check cannot fail and then allow the protected operation to proceed as if the check succeeded.
invariants.positiveTest: pipeline_audit_ablations.test.ts: pipeline aborts when any pre-check fails
invariants.negativeTest: stage_s3_mutation_suite.test.ts: MUTANT-04 Quality gate bypass mutation is KILLED
invariants.failureConsequence: Fail-open vulnerability allowing substandard or spoofed biometric samples into database.

invariants.name: Human Review
invariants.purpose: A biometric duplicate candidate alone cannot trigger an irreversible adverse worker decision; automated matches step up to human KYC.
invariants.positiveTest: biometric_matching.ts: ambiguous match generates review ticket in admin queue
invariants.negativeTest: invariant I-14 enforcement: high similarity score never triggers immediate wallet forfeiture
invariants.failureConsequence: Wrongful automated termination of gig worker accounts due to algorithmic false positives.

invariants.name: Evidence Provenance
invariants.purpose: Every release claim is supported by an identifiable command, result, artifact and applicable environment.
invariants.positiveTest: baseline.json: all 8 S8 manifest files match exact SHA-256 hashes
invariants.negativeTest: S9_BASELINE.md: unconfigured live endpoints explicitly classified as EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED
invariants.failureConsequence: Deployment decisions based on fabricated, outdated, or mock-only test results.
